items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: some guy named Von Slits out of Texas

ctx.x: Yes, and he had some nice guys in the trumpet section, Von Slits -- some guy named Von Slits out of Texas and had two or three other good trumpet players. I didn't remember their names as well, but I would definitely remember Maxwell, because Maxwell would take those solos that, you know --
